nobrainer-auto-fine-tune: Use when setting up Flow the first time or recalibrating client, model, context or parallelism. Alias: nb-auto-fine-tune.
nobrainer-autoimprove: Use when a skill or prompt must improve through a measured baseline-variant loop. Alias: nb-autoimprove.
nobrainer-browser: Use when you must inspect, operate or test a rendered website, or record a Playwright trace. Alias: nb-browser.
nobrainer-build: Use when an approved, bounded code, config, docs or test change must be implemented or simplified. Alias: nb-build.
nobrainer-context: Use when a project's agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, rules) need setup, an audit or tidying. Alias: nb-context.
nobrainer-decide: Use when choosing between options: just decide, decide or deep decide. Alias: nb-decide.
nobrainer-dispatcher: Use when an approved plan has many queued work units to order, batch and route. Alias: nb-dispatcher.
nobrainer-rca: Use when a failure or wrong behavior has an unclear cause and needs an evidence-bound diagnosis. Alias: nb-rca.
nobrainer-research: Use when a task depends on current, niche, uncertain or source-attributed external facts. Alias: nb-research.
nobrainer-review: Use for a CLOSEOUT, BUG_HUNT, RELEASE_GATE, a PR Definition of Done, or implicit state machines. Aliases: nb-review, nb-dod, nb-auto-fix.
nobrainer-security: Use when a change crosses auth, secrets, untrusted input, sensitive data, dependencies or production trust. Alias: nb-security.
nobrainer-sessions: Use when work needs named, reusable sessions, audited handoffs, recovery or controlled parallelism. Alias: nb-sessions.
nobrainer-skill-doctor: Use when a skill or task prompt needs a quality audit, or instructions conflict across projects. Alias: nb-skill-doctor.
nobrainer-spec-driven-development: Use when a change needs a durable specification: architecture, public contracts, migrations or multi-session work. Alias: nb-sdd.
nobrainer-team: Use when an approved Flow plan needs worker assignments, specialist briefs or native parallel execution. Alias: nb-team.
nobrainer-tech-flow: Use to set up, start, resume or complete a task: scope the outcome, delegate only where it helps, verify delivery. Aliases: NBFlow, NBF.
nobrainer-wiki: Use when durable knowledge must be saved, found again, or a Markdown wiki audited; not for task state. Alias: nb-wiki.
nobrainer-writing: Use when user-facing prose needs drafting, rewriting, compressing or review without losing facts. Alias: nb-write.
